Longer description (IDEX): FPGA Pre-pended metadata header containing SUDA’s configuration and status at the time of the trigger, recorded by the FPGA

Science description (IDEX): Time of Flight High Gain waveform
Longer description (IDEX):
Waveform measured at ion detector showing spectrum data for dust impacts at three different amplification gains (each peak represents different ion).  This channel has highest gain, so so smaller peaks are more prominent but big peaks saturate.
Sampled at 260 Msps with 10-bit resolution, from HS ADC #0 channel I.

Science description (IDEX): Time of Flight Low Gain waveform
Longer description (IDEX):
Measures same signal as TOFHG except using lowest gain so that big peaks do not saturate but small peaks are not noticable.
Sampled at 260 Msps with 10-bit resolution, from HS ADC #0 channel Q.

Science description (IDEX): Time of Flight Mid Gain waveform
Longer description (IDEX):
Measures same signal as TOFHG except using mid gain - hopefully few big peaks saturate and few small peaks are not noticed.
Sampled at 260 Msps with 10-bit resolution, from HS ADC #1 channel Q.

Measures the mass of a dust particle by measuring the impact charge, with lower dynamic range (thus TLR).  The interesting part of this signal occurs around the time of impact.
Sampled at 4.0625 Msps with 12-bit resolution.  
Confusingly, this signal is "lower range" but "higher gain".

Measures the mass of a dust particle by measuring the impact charge, with higher dynamic range (thus THR).  The interesting part of this signal occurs around the time of impact.
Sampled at 4.0625 Msps with 12-bit resolution.  
Confusingly, this signal is "higher range" but "lower gain".

Measures the ion charge of a dust particle by measuring the charge pickup from the ion grid electrode.  The interesting part of this signal occurs shortly after the time of impact.  Sampled at 4.0625 Msps with 12-bit resolution.
